inferredConnections.scope: Crown endpoint at [628,180] is a named geometric apex. Raster alpha at row 180 forms a short near-horizontal top run; a curve through the apex and the measured next row is a reconstruction, not an exact raster trace.

White head and white ear roots share one silhouette. The selected source cannot identify a separate head alpha boundary here. Connect only inside the registered ear-root cover; judge the visible union against combinedHeadEarEnvelope. Do not call this hidden connection measured or expose it as a notch.
The middle shallow chin meets the white neck/body. Central chin [628,745] is a visual anchor, not an alpha edge. Preserve the shallow lower-face line and place its completion under the neck.

interpolationNotes: These samples are measurements, not Bezier handles. Use a shape-preserving interpolant; do not allow cubic overshoot to create a V indentation.
A higher sampling density does not resolve the hidden ear/head separation. Keep roots and head on the same registered rest coordinates.
All CPU estimates precede a real raster composition and do not certify the final silhouette or any animation.

combinedEnvelope.purpose: Visible union around the crown/ear shoulder. These rows must not all be relabelled as the separate head boundary.
